result:
The decisions playground is now served at `/ml-inference/playground` instead of `/ml-inference/decisions`. I didn't run tests, the type check or `pnpm build:products`.

- **Manifest:** in `products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx` I changed both the route path and the `decisionPlayground` URL builder to the new address.
- **Generated file:** `frontend/src/products.tsx` is generated from that manifest, so I made the same two edits there by hand. Running `pnpm build:products` should reproduce them and confirm they match.

Every in-app link goes through `urls.decisionPlayground()`, so menu entries, in-app links and the Storybook story pick up the new address without further changes. The scene name, the page and its logic are untouched.

I left the backend API path `/api/projects/:team_id/ml_inference/decisions/decide/` alone. It is an API endpoint, not the page address, and changing it would affect the generated client and the API tests.

I didn't add a redirect from the old `/ml-inference/decisions` address, so bookmarks to it will no longer open the page. I didn't add a test, since nothing in the repo asserts on this path.
